target_customer: Digital businesses in Africa and other emerging markets (fintechs, banks, mobility, e-commerce) that must verify customers for KYC
problem: Verifying individuals and businesses against fragmented national ID, biometric and business registry data in emerging markets.
business_model: Usage-based API priced per verification (about 10 to 20 cents per TechCrunch in 2022)
product_category: Identity verification, KYC and compliance API

founders.name: Lanre Ogungbe
previous_startups: Founding team member of two startups, one acquired (names not given)

founders.name: Niyi Adegboye
education: University graduate with a Mini MBA certificate (institution not named)
previous_startups: Led product, growth, partnerships and fundraising at three startups in EdTech, FinTech and food delivery (not named)
founders.background_notes: YC page lists him as co-founder of Identity Pass.

competitors.name: Youverify
competitors.what: Nigerian KYC and identity verification API
competitors.traction_then: API used by large Nigerian banks and fintechs per 2020 coverage

competitors.name: VerifyMe Nigeria
competitors.what: KYC service for banks, later QoreID orchestration
competitors.traction_then: Reported 10x growth in 2021 per a secondary listing

technical_complexity.rationale: Integrating many national ID and biometric data sources through one API is mostly integration work with uptime and data access hurdles.

defensibility.rationale: Data source integrations and licensing take time to replicate, but several Nigerian rivals sold similar APIs.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought Prembly; it instead bought Tunnel in 2023 and merged with Peleza in 2024.

market_need_then: Nigerian fintechs needed KYC at scale. TechCrunch in May 2022 reported over one million unique verifications processed since launch.

branding.domain_note: prembly.com; earlier product domain not checked.

rebrands.to: Prembly (parent brand; Identitypass kept as a product)
rebrands.why: Expansion beyond KYC into broader compliance and security, per Techeconomy report on the new parent brand

brand_strength.rationale: Regional recognition from press and YC; no evidence of brand-led growth.

outcome_analysis: Prembly grew from Identitypass into a parent brand, raised a small pre-seed and a $2.8M seed in 2022 and reached a team of about 80. It acquired Tunnel in 2023 and merged with Peleza in 2024. No Series A was found, so growth appears capital efficient but later funding is unverified.
notes: Lead investor name varies across outlets (MaC Venture Capital per MaC and Techloy, Marc Ventures per PYMNTS); MaC's own site confirms MaC. Rebrand timing varies (a search result says Sept 2022; the YC news item is dated Dec 2022). CB Insights total of about $3.66M includes a 2025 grant entry; not recorded as a round. Competitor VerifyMe source is dated after the batch.
